details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept: it uses the internal-looking name signup-lib at a synthetic version (99.99.99) so a build that resolves the name from the public registry instead of a private one is detected. Its postinstall hook (node postinstall.js) prints a banner to stderr identifying the package as a security-research canary, then sends one HTTPS GET to hxxps://h1[.]cx/log?depconf=<url-encoded hostname>, carrying only os.hostname(). It reads no files, no environment variables, no tokens or credentials, performs no remote code execution and makes no host changes; the bundled index.js exports an empty object and the package ships only DISCLOSURE/source.txt documentation of the test.
